evidence: The machine has an in-line body layout with gold cyclone cones, a purple rear filter casing, and a red finger trigger on the handle.

candidate_checks.evidence: The V12 Detect Slim uses a top push-button power control on the body rather than the visible red handle trigger.
The V8 family features a perpendicular bin assembly rather than an in-line motor, cyclone, and filter layout.
The in-line layout with gold cyclone assembly, purple filter casing, and red handle trigger matches the V15 Detect.
